decision_questions: Confirm canonical Event kind enum (PR_CENTERED vs PR vs PULL_REQUEST) against Notion Event Contract.
Confirm whether merge commits created on main during merge-commit strategy belong in source_commit_ids.
Confirm exact enum name for default-branch direct-commit Events.
Confirm whether consecutive default-branch direct commits stay 1-per-commit in MVP or use any automatic grouping.
Confirm exact status name (CLASSIFICATION_HELD vs UNCLASSIFIED vs PENDING_ASSOCIATION) when pr_association_status='UNKNOWN'.
Confirm whether held UNKNOWN commits are omitted from default Event search (count=0) or visible in a dedicated pending bucket.
Confirm whether Snapshot Import filters out non-default-branch commits without PRs prior to Event Builder or marks them NON_ELIGIBLE_BRANCH.
Confirm whether searching by a CONTEXT_ONLY ticket key ('SYN-101') should match the attached PR Event in MVP.
Confirm unreferenced issues/tickets produce zero Events and zero held items.
Confirm zero automatic multi-PR merge suggestions/actions occur when two PRs share a CONTEXT_ONLY ticket and author within hours.
Confirm whether MVP Event Builder keeps a mixed-purpose PR as 1 Event without auto-split, and whether a non-binding 'mixed_purpose' hint flag is expected.
Confirm exact parent status after SPLIT (SUPERSEDED vs SPLIT vs ARCHIVED).
Confirm SPLIT partitioning contract for squash-merged 1-commit PRs (file-path scopes vs manual notes).
Confirm whether subsumed members keep lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' (suppressed by membership_state) or transition to a distinct lifecycle status.
Confirm whether MANUAL_MERGE allows combining a PR_CENTERED Event with a DIRECT_COMMIT Event.
Confirm search query matching only a member PR's text rolls up to the owning Composite Event exactly once.
Confirm direct GET behavior for a subsumed member Event ID (member + parent pointer vs redirect).
Confirm whether EXCLUDE is reversible in MVP (RESTORE/INCLUDE) and whether excluding a Composite cascades to members.
Confirm exact terminal status for dissolved Composite (DISSOLVED vs ARCHIVED).
Confirm Claim re-linking/detachment behavior when a Composite referenced by Claims is dissolved (cross-check CLAIM-QA).
Confirm exact sub-conditions mapping to CANNOT_LINK when non-Event IDs (CONTEXT_ONLY ticket, UNKNOWN commit) are supplied to MANUAL_MERGE.
Confirm flat 1-level Composite policy (rejecting nested Composite / already-subsumed member with CANNOT_LINK) vs allowing append to an existing Composite.
Confirm exact error_code (VERSION_CONFLICT vs STALE_VERSION), HTTP status (409 vs 412), and whether optimistic lock is per-Event version or per-Workspace version.
Align with OD-010 resource-hiding decision: should cross-workspace commands return WORKSPACE_CONFLICT, CANNOT_LINK, or existence-hiding 403/404?
Confirm whether POST_MVP fixtures should encode MVP non-ingestion (current draft) or target B-003 post-sync Event state behind a POST_MVP harness flag.
Confirm whether held UNKNOWN items are locked from user curation until B-003 recovers association.
Decide whether to add a second POST_MVP variant where late recovery confirms pr_association_status='NONE'.
